static_traits.name: Fang Jie
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends, but finds it hard to open up to them about Loneliness and shyness; Interpersonal relationships damaged after Divorce, difficulty building new connections
static_traits.medical_history: Long experiencing shyness and isolation in Social situations; has not received treatment for this problem before; No major physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: I feel my shyness makes people unwilling to talk to me, leading to Loneliness and feelings of being isolated.
basic_info.core_demands: Recently divorced and increasingly strong feelings of Loneliness prompting me to seek counseling, to cope with shyness and improve social interactions.
growth_experiences: Since childhood, long experiencing shyness and isolation in social settings; despite some career success, still often feels disconnected from others and finds interaction difficult in work and community activities, gradually forming experiences of self-doubt and low self-worth.

After Recently divorced, Interpersonal relationships significantly affected, feelings of Loneliness and isolation worsened, building new interpersonal connections even harder; more frequently experiencing being avoided and misunderstood at Work and community activities, while finding it even harder to open up to existing friends.

core_beliefs: Others are unwilling to accept me (do not want to talk to me)

special_situations.event: After poor performance on a project, recalling the failure and finding it hard to start new projects
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the project fails, it proves I am just a failure; success and failure are black-and-white, either capable or not
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids starting new projects, reduces attempts to avoid failing again; frequently ruminates on failure experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Not doing the project well proves I am just a failure

special_situations.event: In Social situations at Work and community activities, others not yet proactively chatting with me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am very shy, people will not want to talk to me; others' Silence equals not liking me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to speak up, while reducing deep communication to avoid Being rejected
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not want to talk to me, because I am too shy

special_situations.event: After discussing the poor project with friends, repeatedly seeking evaluation, friends showing impatience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If friends do not give affirmation, it means my Work is terrible, I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously seeking external affirmation and comfort from friends to relieve unease
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He thinks I am not good enough, I should trust myself more but I cannot

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is success, it is just luck, cannot represent my ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive evidence, continuing to focus on failure to maintain self-narrative consistency

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized, build stable and close connections, and at the same time prove self-worth professionally
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and Being rejected leading to self-worth being negated; fearing others' judgment and impatience
defense_goal: Through seeking external approval, temporarily stabilizes self-worth
Reduces attempts or avoids new projects to lower the risk of failure and shame
Staying cautious and Self-protecting in socializing to avoid Being rejected

object_relations.self_representation: not good enough, a lonely person easily Being rejected
object_relations.object_representation: Others are judgers and rejecters, impatient with oneself

object_relations.self_representation: A dependent person who needs others' affirmation to feel worthy
object_relations.object_representation: Friends are authoritative givers of recognition, but may become annoyed and distant

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When guided in counseling or conversation to focus on past successful projects and refute the failure narrative with positive evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes success is just luck, not enough to prove oneself capable (viewing positive evidence as unreliable)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone flat, emphasizes words such as 'luck', 'coincidence', downplaying the meaning of success, returning to failure cases to explain.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends or the counselor show impatience at her repeated seeking of affirmation or suggest she trust herself more
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client understands others' impatience as 'I am the problem', internalizing negative evaluations into the self
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone self-blaming, lowering self-worth, using expressions like 'It is all my fault' 'I am not worthy', reducing expression of one's needs.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the other party is silent or interaction decreases in social settings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client concludes others are unwilling to talk to her, looking down on herself (mind-reading and attributing negative feelings to others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Speaking in a manner of guessing others' negative thoughts, with a cautious and distant tone, reducing proactive in-depth communication.

manifestations: Since childhood, long felt shy and isolated in social situations
Loneliness intensified after Divorce, difficulty building new interpersonal connections
In work and community activities, feels avoided by people; hard to interact with colleagues and parents
Finding it hard to openly express Loneliness and shyness when with friends
outcomes: Persistent Loneliness and sense of isolation
Seeking others' validation leading to Relationship tension

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worrying about burdening friends, unwilling to open up
Frequently seeking others' recognition of Work to relieve unease
In social interactions, is careful and cautious, reduces in-depth communication

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Understanding others' Silence in Social situations as unwilling to talk to oneself or looking down on oneself
Attributing one's shyness and feelings of not being accepted to others' attitudes

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Views career success or failure as an absolute black-and-white standard (either success or failure)
Internalizes external performance outcomes as the sole basis of self-worth

positive_force: Having certain career stability (Work performance not yet directly affected)
Still has a few close friends who can provide some support
Willing to try behavioral experiments, holds an open and exploratory attitude
In social situations, able to push himself to proactively start conversations
negative_force: Self-worth highly tied to project success or failure
Excessively seeking external approval, prone to causing Interpersonal tension
Negating positive results, focusing on failure evidence
Social mind-reading and personalization tendencies, presetting others as unwilling to communicate

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding or delaying starting new projects
antecedent: Thinking about past poor project performance
Anticipating possible failure when facing new projects
target_behavior.core_reason: Absolutely binding project outcomes to self-worth, interpreting success and failure in black-and-white; failure viewed as the whole person not being good enough
target_behavior.function: Avoiding failure and negative evaluation, to lower Anxiety and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Motivation significantly declining, Sleep affected, Career development hindered

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly seeks recognition and comfort about work from friends
antecedent: Low mood after poor project performance
When Self-doubting and believing 'oneself is not good enough'
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth depends on external affirmation, lacking stability of internal self-evaluation
target_behavior.function: Gains comfort and brief security, stabilizing self-worth
target_behavior.consequence: Friends developing impatience, Interpersonal tension, further intensifying Loneliness

target_behavior.behavior: Reducing deep communication or leaving early in Social situations (Social avoidance)
antecedent: Interactive situations at work and in community activities
Social pressure and worry about being misunderstood after Divorce
target_behavior.core_reason: Shyness and 'mind-reading' tendencies leading to predictions of Being rejected and personalized Interpretations
target_behavior.function: Avoiding Being rejected or embarrassment, lowering Social anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Increased Loneliness and isolation, difficulty building new connections and maintaining friendships
